prose: Microsoft AI launched MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming, a real-time speech-to-text model, plus two voice models, MAI-Voice-2.1 and a faster Flash variant. The transcriber supports 60 languages with continuous language detection and produces first partial hypotheses in just over 100 ms, then revises them and commits a stable transcript.

Microsoft says it ranks first for accuracy on Artificial Analysis and sits on the accuracy-versus-latency frontier, with words appearing about twice as fast as its closest competitor in internal tests. Streaming is priced at an introductory $0.54 per hour of audio through year end. MAI-Voice-2.1 covers 23 languages and 26 locales with one voice speaking each with a native accent.
highlights: MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming: 60 languages, partials in about 100 ms.
